arguments.code:
import math

# Login
token = apis.spotify.login(username='ch-burch@gmail.com', password='99W1c[K')
access_token = token['access_token']

# Fetch all playlists in library (page through)
playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
    print('page', page_index, 'returned', len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('total playlists', len(playlists))

# Compute total duration per playlist
results=[]
for p in playlists:
    pl_id = p['playlist_id']
    pl_title = p['title']
    details = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl_id, access_token=access_token)
    durations = [s['duration'] for s in details['songs']]
    total_seconds = sum(durations)
    total_minutes = total_seconds/60
    results.append({
        'playlist_id': pl_id,
        'title': pl_title,
        'num_songs': len(durations),
        'total_seconds': total_seconds,
        'total_minutes': total_minutes,
    })

# Sort by total minutes
results_sorted = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['total_minutes'])
print('playlist durations (minutes) sorted:')
for r in results_sorted:
    print(r['playlist_id'], r['title'], 'songs', r['num_songs'], 'minutes', r['total_minutes'])

shortest = results_sorted[0]
shortest_minutes_rounded = int(round(shortest['total_minutes']))
print('shortest playlist', shortest['playlist_id'], shortest['title'], 'minutes exact', shortest['total_minutes'], 'rounded', shortest_minutes_rounded)

shortest_minutes_rounded
